mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with sustained HOUST increase, or HOUST growth does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a slowing economy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decrease > 2% MoM does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by more than 0.25% in a single month, it signals an immediate easing of monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).
